title: Demo: Caribbean Route Overview (Synthetic)
disclaimer: SYNTHETIC DEMO CONTENT — not real RCG policy.
content: The approved demo Caribbean route content describes warm-water sailing among trusted port stops such as Cozumel, Roatan, and Nassau depending on the selected sailing fixture. Western Caribbean itineraries often emphasize reef snorkeling and Mayan heritage excursions, while Eastern Caribbean routes highlight beach days and colonial architecture. Geography labels and map positions in Voyage Canvas come from curated local port data, not from AI-generated coordinates. This description is for guest education only and does not affect pricing or inventory.
